summary: Operation against a Strait of Gibraltar drug-trafficking organisation announced; seizures included two hexacopters (a type of drone) alongside vehicles, boats, firearms and cash. Drone use purpose not stated.
source_title: Operación contra el narco del Estrecho: un capo en Dubai, 57 toneladas de coca y un silencio de 12 millones
quote: 70 vehículos, 30 embarcaciones, tres armas de fuego, más de 800.000 euros, dos hexacópteros (un tipo de dron), múltiples cuentas bancarias, más de 150 teléfonos móviles
quote_translation: 70 vehicles, 30 boats, three firearms, over 800,000 euros, two hexacopters (a type of drone), multiple bank accounts, over 150 mobile phones

summary: Police arrested four men, two minors, in a parked car at a known drone launch spot near Beauvais prison with a drone and parcels of cannabis resin and herb.
payload_detail: cannabis resin and herb in parcels packed for dropping
source_title: Beauvais : après le survol de la prison par un drone, quatre hommes dont deux mineurs interpellés avec de la drogue - ici.fr
quote: La police nationale de l'Oise a mis la main, dimanche 18 janvier à Beauvais, sur quatre personnes soupçonnées d'avoir opéré un parachutage d'objets par drone à destination du centre pénitentiaire.
quote_translation: Oise national police caught, on Sunday 18 January in Beauvais, four people suspected of dropping objects by drone to the prison.

summary: A drone sighted by wall guards was recovered and seized inside the detention area; third drone recovered in two months, per union Osapp.
source_title: Allarme per ennesima intrusione con un drone nel carcere di Saluzzo, la terza in due mesi
quote: Questa mattina (sabato), invece, alle 9,40, all’interno dell’area detentiva è stato recuperato e sequestrato un drone, che era stato precedentemente avvistato dal personale impegnato nel servizio di vigilanza armata sul muro di cinta dell’istituto.
quote_translation: This Saturday morning at 9:40 a drone was recovered and seized inside the detention area, having earlier been sighted by staff on armed watch on the perimeter wall.

summary: Police on patrol saw a drone overflying the Hohenleuben prison at about 1 a.m.; the pilot withdrew the drone and was not found. The grounds were searched and nothing was found. Proceedings opened against unknown person.
payload_detail: No contraband found on search of prison grounds
source_title: Während Streifenfahrt: Polizei beobachtet illegalen Drohnenflug über Haftanstalt
quote: Als der Drohnenführer mutmaßlich via Bildübertragung feststellte, dass seine Drohne bemerkt wurde, entfernte sich das Fluggerät und konnte nicht mehr ausgemacht werden.
quote_translation: When the drone operator presumably realised via the video feed that his drone had been noticed, the aircraft moved away and could no longer be located.

summary: Guardia Civil Pegaso team jammed a drone in flight heading for Ceuta prison. The drone was found and seized carrying narcotics and two micro mobile phones. Case handled by the 1st Fiscal Company. Exact flight date not given; 2026-01-16 is the article date.
payload_detail: narcotics (hashish per headline lead) and two micro mobile phones
source_title: La Guardia Civil inhibe un dron que llevaba droga y micro-teléfonos a la cárcel
quote: Tras ello, el dron fue localizado e incautado, comprobado que llevaba sustancias estupefacientes y dos micro-teléfonos móviles
quote_translation: After that, the drone was located and seized, and found to be carrying narcotics and two micro mobile phones.

summary: Police were alerted at 3:30 on 4 January 2026 to a drone over Beauvais prison; a drone and drugs were found in a car; one passenger fled, a 21-year-old woman was arrested and on 5 January sentenced to ten months for complicity and cannabis possession.
payload_detail: cannabis in an undelivered bag
source_title: Prison de Beauvais. Une jeune femme condamnée pour avoir aidé à remettre des colis par drone aux détenus - Oise Hebdo
quote: La jeune femme de 21 ans comparaît pour complicité après que les policiers sont intervenus pour une tentative de livraison par drone sur la prison de Beauvais dans la nuit du 3 au 4 janvier.
quote_translation: The 21-year-old woman is tried for complicity after police intervened over an attempted drone delivery at Beauvais prison in the night of 3 to 4 January.

summary: Guardia Civil Equipo PEGASO detected and jammed a drone carrying drugs and two micro mobile phones heading for Mendizábal prison; the drone was recovered and seized. No arrests reported.
payload_detail: unspecified narcotics, two micro mobile phones
source_title: La Guardia Civil neutralizó un dron con droga y móviles en la prisión de Mendizábal
quote: En su interior transportaba  sustancias estupefacientes  y  dos micro-teléfonos móviles , elementos que suelen emplearse para eludir los controles de seguridad existentes en el interior de los centros penitenciarios
quote_translation: Inside it was carrying narcotic substances and two micro mobile phones, items usually used to evade security controls inside prisons.

summary: Operation Vaper: searches at hideouts of two suspected gunmen in Marbella and Mijas, hired by drug trafficking organisations, found a drone alongside firearms, cocaine, night-vision device and satellite phone.
source_title: Un ceutí y un joven de Algeciras, identificados como tiradores del ataque a la Policía en Isla Mayor
quote: En los registros se hallaron dos armas cortas, un importante alijo de cocaína y material operativo como un visor nocturno, telefonía satelital y un dron.
quote_translation: The searches found two handguns, a significant stash of cocaine and operational material such as a night-vision device, satellite telephony and a drone.

summary: A 26-year-old former inmate was sentenced to six years for running an organised network delivering to prisoners in northern France by unmanned vehicles; orders were placed via Snapchat and profits exceeded two million euros.
source_title: Γαλλία: Drones μετέφεραν... ναρκωτικά σε φυλακές – 5 συλλήψεις
quote: Τον Ιανουάριο, ένας 26χρονος, πρώην κρατούμενος και ο ίδιος, καταδικάστηκε σε εξαετή κάθειρξη, γιατί διηύθυνε ένα εξελιγμένο δίκτυο παραδόσεων με μη επανδρωμένα οχήματα σε κρατούμενους στη βόρεια Γαλλία.
quote_translation: In January, a 26-year-old, himself a former inmate, was sentenced to six years' imprisonment for running a sophisticated network delivering to inmates in northern France with unmanned vehicles.

summary: Prison sources say a serving prisoner is under investigation as a person of interest for drone activity and is believed to have tried to arrange drops at the jail. No charge reported; MoJ declined to comment on the individual.
source_title: Acid thug Arthur Collins under investigation over 'prison drone drops linked to organised crime'
quote: 'He was under investigation for drones, and they feared he was in touch with people on the outside who might arrange drops at the jail.

summary: Drone carrying hashish, mobile phones and other illicit material landed in the exercise yards of Poggioreale prison and was intercepted by prison police.
payload_detail: hashish, mobile phones, other illicit material
source_title: Carcere Poggioreale: intercettato ancora un drone con droga e telefonini
quote: Un drone con a bordo hashish, telefoni cellulari e altro materiale illecito, atterrato nei passeggi del carcere partenopeo G. Salvia di Poggioreale (coordinato dalla direttrice Giulia Russo) è stato intercettato e bloccato dalla polizia penitenziaria.
quote_translation: A drone carrying hashish, mobile phones and other illicit material, landed in the exercise yards of the Naples prison G. Salvia in Poggioreale, was intercepted and stopped by prison police.

summary: Prison police recovered a drone, ten mobile phones and drugs inside Foggia prison in night operations by about 150 officers, per union Osapp.
payload_detail: 10 phones with chargers, several drug doses
source_title: Foggia, trovati in carcere cellulari, droga e un drone. «Urgono interventi strutturali»
quote: Dieci telefoni cellulari con relativi kit di ricarica, diverse dosi di sostanze stupefacenti e un drone sono stati intercettati e recuperati dalla polizia penitenziaria all’interno del carcere di Foggia durante operazioni notturne
quote_translation: Ten mobile phones with chargers, several doses of drugs and a drone were intercepted and recovered by prison police inside Foggia prison during night operations.

summary: Border Guard officers from Kuźnica found packages near Supraśl carrying 7,000 packs of cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps, smuggled by drone. Same report covers a separate balloon drop near Długosielce. No arrests reported.
payload_detail: 7,000 packs of cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps
source_title: Balony z papierosami i dron. Przemyt o wartości ponad 92 tys. zł trafił w ręce Straży Granicznej
quote: Również mundurowi z Kuźnicy w rejonie Supraśla ujawnili kolejne pakunki zawierające papierosy, tym razem przemycone przy wykorzystaniu drona.
quote_translation: Also officers from Kuźnica found further packages containing cigarettes in the Supraśl area, this time smuggled using a drone.

summary: Headline reports cannabis, cocaine and phones delivered by drone into a prison (Vivonne, Vienne) and three young men arrested by gendarmerie; article body not retrieved.
payload_detail: cannabis, cocaine, phones (per headline)
source_title: Cannabis, cocaïne et téléphones livrés par drone dans une prison : trois jeunes hommes interpellés par la gendarmerie
quote: Cannabis, cocaïne et téléphones livrés par drone dans une prison : trois jeunes hommes interpellés par la gendarmerie
quote_translation: Cannabis, cocaine and phones delivered by drone into a prison: three young men arrested by gendarmerie.

summary: Gang stealing VW emblems with radar sensors in London summer 2026 reportedly used a drone to scan a residential area and map parked car positions before the theft.
source_title: Koster 1.000-vis af kroner – tyve stjæler fra din bil på 5 sekunder
quote: I mindst ét tilfælde har banden angiveligt brugt en drone til at afsøge boligområdet og kortlægge bilernes præcise placering før kuppet.
quote_translation: In at least one case the gang has allegedly used a drone to scout the residential area and map the exact location of the cars before the theft.

place: Casa circondariale di contrada Noce, Caltagirone
summary: Drone carrying a package (300 g hashish, two smartphones) blocked by prison police at Caltagirone prison; one of four smuggling attempts foiled within a few days (first).
payload_detail: 300 g hashish, two smartphones
source_title: Droni, droga e cellulari: sventati quattro “lanci” all’interno del carcere
quote: Nel primo episodio è stata bloccato il tentativo di far entrare in carcere, tramite un  drone , un pacco con  300 grammi di hashish  e  due smartphone .

summary: Carabinieri seized a drone near Poggioreale prison carrying a bag with three smartphones, 200 g hashish and about 4 g crack, destined for inmates. Investigations attribute such deliveries to Camorra clans.
payload_detail: 3 smartphones, 200 g hashish, about 4 g crack
source_title: Polizei fängt in Neapel Drogen-Drohne ab
quote: Die Lieferung war für Insassen des Gefängnisses Poggioreale in Neapel bestimmt. Die Drohne wurde in der Umgebung der Einrichtung lokalisiert.
quote_translation: The delivery was intended for inmates of Poggioreale prison in Naples. The drone was located in the vicinity of the facility.

summary: Police arrested a man piloting a drone near the prison in the night of Sunday to Monday. Drone, phones, drugs and cigarettes seized; the man resisted arrest, lightly injuring officers, and was placed in custody and referred to court.
source_title: Interpellation sous tension dans l'Aude, le pilote de drone ne comptait pas se laisser faire...
quote: Les policiers carcassonnais ont interpellé un individu qui utilisait un drone pour acheminer divers objets interdits vers l’établissement pénitentiaire.
quote_translation: Carcassonne police arrested an individual who was using a drone to carry various prohibited items to the prison.

summary: Night staff recovered three drone parcels at Châteaudun detention centre containing cannabis resin, cocaine, phones, gas canisters, tools, glue and a SIM card.
payload_detail: cannabis resin, cocaine pouches (weight unknown), iPhones, gas canisters, precision screwdriver, glue tubes, SIM card
source_title: Prison de Châteaudun : Établissement en Danger ! Livraisons, Drones, Suspicion d’Arme - Syndicat FO Justice
quote: La dernière saisie de la nuit du 16 décembre 2025 est l’illustration de notre quotidien :  Pas moins de trois colis ont été récupérés par le service de nuit !
quote_translation: The last seizure, night of 16 December 2025, illustrates our daily life: no fewer than three parcels were recovered by the night service!

summary: Prison staff intercepted a drone parcel at Châteaudun detention centre, per a union statement; content not stated.
source_title: Prison de Châteaudun : Établissement en Danger ! Livraisons, Drones, Suspicion d’Arme - Syndicat FO Justice
quote:
Nuit du 12 décembre 2025, interception d’un colis drone… 
 La dernière saisie de la nuit du 16 décembre 2025 est l’illustration de notre quotidien :  Pas moins de trois colis
quote_translation: Night of 12 December 2025, interception of a drone parcel… The last seizure, night of 16 December 2025, illustrates our daily life: no fewer than three parcels

summary: Prison staff intercepted a drone parcel at Châteaudun detention centre, per a union statement; content not stated.
source_title: Prison de Châteaudun : Établissement en Danger ! Livraisons, Drones, Suspicion d’Arme - Syndicat FO Justice
quote: Nuit du lundi 10 décembre 2025, interception d’un colis drone…
quote_translation: Night of Monday 10 December 2025, interception of a drone parcel…

summary: Gendarmes found a parked car near Uzerche detention centre at 4 a.m. containing a drone with a release system and a parcel of three phones and a charger; the 18-year-old was sentenced to 12 months.
payload_detail: 3 phones and a charger
source_title: Il avait tenté une livraison par drone au centre de détention d'Uzerche - Totem Radio
quote: À l’intérieur, ils découvrent un drone équipé d’un système de largage et un colis contenant trois téléphones et un chargeur.
quote_translation: Inside, they find a drone fitted with a release system and a parcel containing three phones and a charger.

summary: Three people aged 24, 27 and 54 arrested in Nantes in December 2025, suspected of running a Snapchat account selling drone deliveries of phones, drugs, knives and electronics to seven prisons in western France; also charged with buying a drone able to carry 1 kg. Trial set for 29 January 2026.
payload_detail: phones, drugs, bladed weapons, high-tech equipment
source_title: INFO BFMTV. Plus de 2.000 livraisons illégales en prison par drone recensées en 2025, cinq fois plus qu'en 2024
quote: Elles sont soupçonnées d'avoir géré un compte Snapchat de livraison par drone de téléphones, stupéfiants, armes blanches et même de matériel high-tech à destination de sept établissements pénitentiaires de l'ouest de la France.
quote_translation: They are suspected of running a Snapchat account for drone delivery of phones, drugs, bladed weapons and even high-tech equipment to seven prisons in western France.

summary: Two men were caught trying to smuggle drugs into HMP Parc by drone; a package of illicit substances was recovered from the prison grounds and both were jailed. Offence date not stated.
source_title: Drone used in attempt to smuggle drugs and phones into prison
quote: Last month Kyle Morris and Nicholas Mann were also caught trying to smuggle drugs into Parc via a drone.

summary: Prison officers at Mountjoy warned of a kidnap plot by senior inmates, reportedly retaliating against a crackdown on drone deliveries of drugs and weapons.
source_title: Mountjoy Prison officers advised to review personal security after kidnap threat
quote: It is understood that the kidnap plan had been hatched by senior criminals at the prison in response to a Mountjoy crackdown on illegal drone deliveries.

summary: Prison police found a professional drone outside the walls of Lanciano prison and seized about half a kilo of cocaine and cannabis plus two iPhones.
payload_detail: about 0.5 kg cocaine and marijuana, 2 iPhones
source_title: Mezzo chilo di droga e due telefonini introdotti con un drone, scatta il sequestro al carcere di Lanciano - ChietiToday
quote: gli agenti hanno individuato, all'esterno delle mura dell'istituto, un drone di tipo professionale, un modello costoso, utilizzato per l'introduzione di sostanza stupefacente e dispositivi elettronici nell'istituto.
quote_translation: the officers spotted, outside the institute's walls, a professional-type drone, an expensive model, used to bring drugs and electronic devices into the institute.

summary: Prison police at Ucciardone stopped two men flying a drone outside the prison to bring in drugs and mobile phones; seized drugs said by a union to be worth about 20,000 euro and two phones. The two were taken to Pagliarelli prison.
payload_detail: drugs (~20,000 euro per union), 2 phones
source_title: Ucciardone, cercavano di introdurre droga e cellulari con un drone: arrestati due uomini, condotti al Pagliarelli
quote: La Polizia Penitenziaria del carcere Ucciardone ha bloccato due uomini che, pilotando un drone all’esterno dell’istituto penitenziario, stavano tentando di far entrare all’interno sostanze stupefacenti e telefoni cellulari
quote_translation: Prison police at Ucciardone stopped two men who, flying a drone outside the prison, were trying to bring in drugs and mobile phones.

summary: Two inmates escaped Dijon prison by sawing cell bars with blades the prosecutor said were very likely delivered by drone; one was recaptured the next day.
payload_detail: saw blades
source_title: France catches one of two escapees in bed sheet prison break
quote: It was very likely the saws were delivered by drones, Caracotch said, adding that the Dijon court had recently sentenced an individual over drone deliveries to the same jail, “including of saw blades”.

summary: Guardia Civil patrol guarding a seized narcolancha reports a large drone loitering nearby, alongside a helicopter and a boat approaching the vessel. Relayed by the AUGC association.
source_title: La AUGC denuncia falta de medios en la lucha contra el narcotráfico
quote: un helicóptero sobrevolando la zona, una embarcación acercándose a la narcolancha y un dron de grandes dimensiones merodeando
quote_translation: a helicopter overflying the area, a boat approaching the narcolancha and a large drone loitering

summary: Gendarmes interrupted a drone delivery to inmates at night; the driver fled, abandoning his father's car, and was later identified and arrested. He admitted delivering parcels for a small sum. Drone equipment seized.
source_title: Livraison par drone à des détenus de Villeneuve-lès-Maguelone : il abandonne sa voiture à la vue des gendarmes, avant d’être interpellé
quote: Une livraison par drone à des détenus de Villeneuve-lès-Maguelone a été interrompue par les gendarmes, dans la nuit de samedi à dimanche 16 novembre à 4 h 30 du matin.
quote_translation: A drone delivery to inmates at Villeneuve-lès-Maguelone was interrupted by gendarmes in the night of Saturday to Sunday 16 November at 4:30 am.

place: HMP Highpoint, Suffolk (planned drop; bag recovered at field off the A143)
summary: Man tracked by police met co-conspirators, collected a bag and walked into a field near the A143; abandoned the bag containing a drone, cannabis, tobacco, phones and SIM cards when under surveillance. Convicted of conspiracy to convey banned items into prison; sentence raised on appeal.
payload_detail: cannabis, tobacco, mobile phones, SIM cards, dongles, charging equipment
source_title: Man who tried to fly drugs and phones into Suffolk prison hit with more jail time - East Anglian Daily Times
quote: The bag contained a drone with a range of more than three miles, along with cannabis, tobacco, mobile phones, SIM cards, dongles and charging equipment.

summary: Drone carrying a package with mobile phones and drugs for inmates intercepted by prison police overnight; carabinieri failed to catch the operator.
source_title: Bloccato drone con droga e cellulari al carcere di Foggia
quote: Un drone che avrebbe dovuto portare a detenuti del carcere di Foggia un involucro contenente telefoni cellulari e sostanza stupefacente è stato intercettato dalla polizia penitenziaria la notte scorsa.
quote_translation: A drone that was to bring inmates of Foggia prison a package containing mobile phones and drugs was intercepted by prison police last night.

summary: Police arresting a 35-year-old man in a South Shields hotel found cocaine, pregabalin, cannabis resin, several drones and crisp packets with drugs and mini phones attached to plans to fly them into a prison. Arrested on suspicion of Class A possession with intent to supply; released on bail.
payload_detail: crisp packets with drugs and mini mobile phones; cocaine, pregabalin, cannabis resin in room
source_title: Tyneside police officers foil suspected prison smuggling plot and seize drugs and drones
quote: They also discovered a number of drones and two crisp packets containing quantities of drugs and mini mobile phones, attached to crude plans to fly them into prison.

place: Alcalá de los Gazules, Vejer de la Frontera, Tarifa, Algeciras, San Roque (Cádiz)
summary: Operation Ruche: Guardia Civil with Royal Moroccan Gendarmerie arrested nine members of a group flying home-built fixed-wing drones (range over 200 km) from Alcalá de los Gazules to Morocco and back, dropping hashish near Vejer and Tarifa. 8 drones seized, 10 more in assembly; 210 kg hashish and EUR 320,000 seized.
payload_detail: 210 kg hashish seized; about 200 kg per night introduced
source_title: Detenida una organización criminal que utilizaba drones de ala fija para el tráfico de drogas en el Estrecho
quote: La Guardia Civil ha detenido a una organización criminal dedicada a la introducción de hachís desde Marruecos a través del Estrecho mediante el uso de drones artesanales ensamblados por los propios integrantes del grupo.
quote_translation: The Guardia Civil has arrested a criminal organisation dedicated to bringing hashish in from Morocco across the Strait using home-made drones assembled by the group's own members.

place: Alcalá de los Gazules, Cádiz (workshop and launch site); drops near Vejer de la Frontera and Tarifa
summary: Guardia Civil (Operation Ruche, with Moroccan Gendarmerie and Europol) dismantled a network flying home-assembled fixed-wing drones between Morocco and Cádiz province carrying hashish. Nine arrested; over 150 kg hashish, EUR 320,000 cash and 18 drones seized in searches on 10 November 2025.
payload_detail: hashish, up to about 200 kg per night capacity; over 150 kg seized
source_title: Cae una red de narcos que usaba drones para pasar de Marruecos a Cádiz hasta 200 kilos de hachís al día
quote: La Guardia Civil ha desmantelado una red de narcotráfico que utilizaba drones de fabricación artesanal para introducir hachís desde Marruecos hasta la provincia de Cádiz.
quote_translation: The Guardia Civil has dismantled a drug-trafficking network that used home-built drones to bring hashish from Morocco into Cádiz province.

place: Centre de détention de Gradignan, Gironde
summary: Police anti-crime unit arrested two men aged 22 and 24 near Gradignan prison at 4 a.m. carrying a drone with a release mechanism and a bag smelling of cannabis.
payload_detail: bag smelling strongly of cannabis; contents not stated
source_title: Prison de Gradignan : deux hommes suspectés de livraison de drogue par drone arrêtés - Sud Ouest
quote: Les suspects sont rapidement arrêtés : ils avaient sur eux un drone équipé d’un système de largage et un sac à dos qui sentait très fort le cannabis.
quote_translation: The suspects are quickly arrested: they had on them a drone fitted with a drop system and a rucksack smelling strongly of cannabis.

summary: Border Guard found a drone with about 400 packs of cigarettes bearing Belarusian excise stamps in Krynki commune, after a resident tipped the Szudziałowo post; fire service and police called. No arrests reported.
payload_detail: approx 400 packs of cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps
source_title: Próba przemytu dronem
quote: Dron wypełniony nielegalnymi papierosami ujawnili dziś funkcjonariusze Straży Granicznej w gminie Krynki. Informacja o obiekcie wpłynęła do Placówki SG w Szudziałowie od jednego z mieszkańców pogranicza.
quote_translation: Border Guard officers today found a drone filled with illegal cigarettes in Krynki commune. Information about the object reached the Szudziałowo SG post from a resident of the border area.

place: Strait of Gibraltar area, southern Spain
summary: Guardia Civil dismantled a criminal organisation using fixed-wing drones to move hashish from northern Morocco to the Spanish coast; nine arrested, drones, hashish and cash seized.
payload_detail: hashish, quantity described only as considerable
source_title: Drugssmokkel met drones van Marokko naar Spanje - Crimesite
quote: Er zijn negen personen aangehouden. Tijdens de actie werden meerdere drones in beslag genomen en aanzienlijke hoeveelheden hasj en contant geld gevonden.
quote_translation: Nine people were arrested. During the action several drones were seized and considerable quantities of hashish and cash were found.

place: La Línea de la Concepción, Cádiz
summary: Policía Nacional operation 'Sombra Negra' dismantled a maritime cocaine network; a front company in La Línea supplied it with drones, jammers, GPS trackers and satellite comms. 105 arrested, 10,400 kg cocaine seized.
payload_detail: 10,400 kg cocaine seized in the operation (drone payload not stated)
source_title: 'Sombra Negra', la operación que tumbó al narco más poderoso del Atlántico con sede en el Campo de Gibraltar
quote: Una parte fundamental del entramado se encontraba en La Línea de la Concepción, donde operaba una empresa utilizada como una tapadera para suministrar drones, inhibidores de frecuencia, localizadores GPS y sistemas de comunicación por satélite.
quote_translation: A key part of the network was in La Línea de la Concepción, where a company operated as a front to supply drones, frequency jammers, GPS trackers and satellite communication systems.

summary: Metal saw blades were delivered by drone into a Dijon prison; two remand prisoners used them to cut window bars and escaped at the end of November 2025. Both were later recaptured.
payload_detail: metal saw blades
source_title: Spektakuläre Flucht aus französischem Gefängnis: Zwei Häftlinge entkommen mit Sägeblatt und Bettlaken
quote: Nach Angaben der Staatsanwaltschaft waren die Metallsägeblätter per Drohne in das Gefängnis geliefert worden. Der Hof der Haftanstalt war bislang nicht mit Abfangnetzen für Drohnen ausgestattet.
quote_translation: According to the prosecutor's office, the metal saw blades had been delivered into the prison by drone. The prison yard had so far not been equipped with interception nets for drones.

summary: Man seen by undercover officers in woods near HMP Manchester on 21 September with a drone and wrapped items; jailed six years for conspiracy to bring prohibited items into prison.
payload_detail: items wrapped in socks; possession of cannabis charged
source_title: The Greater Manchester residents now waking up behind bars - Manchester Evening News
quote: A man who flew a drone over prisons including Strangeways has been locked up after a haul of contraband he tried to smuggle inside was discovered.

summary: Prison police recovered 750 g of hashish on the roofs of Avellino prison, probably carried by a drone, per the Sappe union.
payload_detail: 750 g hashish
source_title: Avellino. Drone lancia droga sul tetto del carcere - Telenostra
quote: La Polizia Penitenziaria ha recuperato 750 grammi di hashish, trasportata probabilmente da un drone, sui tetti del carcere di Avellino.
quote_translation: Prison police recovered 750 g of hashish, probably carried by a drone, on the roofs of Avellino prison.

summary: Three inmates received phones and weapons (knives, knuckledusters) by drone on a 20 m line to their cell window, coordinated by phone with a person outside; reported in the prosecutor's search decree.
source_title: Droni e minacce: così i detenuti gestivano lo spaccio nel carcere di Prato - Il Fatto Quotidiano
quote: Tre detenuti si approvvigionavano di cellulari e armi (coltelli e tirapugni) impiegando un drone con una lenza lunga venti metri impiegata per trasportare i plichi contenenti detto materiale sino alla finestra della loro cella
quote_translation: Three inmates obtained phones and weapons (knives and knuckledusters) using a drone with a twenty-metre line to carry the packages to their cell window.

place: near Mostyska, 7 km from the Polish border
summary: A father and son from Lviv oblast tried to send almost 3,000 packs of unstamped cigarettes to Poland with fixed-wing drones; detained near Mostyska by border guards.
payload_detail: almost 3,000 packs of cigarettes without excise stamps
source_title: Батько зі сином намагались переправити дронами сигарети до Польщі

source_title: Forget the cake: Drone flies contraband metal saws into a French jail
quote: Employees at the facility found the conked-out craft in the northern yard of the prison on the morning of August 9. Splayed out beside it was a payload of wiring for cell phones, material for a water pipe, and several metal saw blades

summary: A drone crashed in the north yard of Nîmes prison overnight 8-9 August 2021; guards found phone cables, shisha equipment and small saw blades. Judicial and internal inquiries opened.
payload_detail: phone cables, shisha equipment, small saw blades
source_title: Nîmes : des détenus se font livrer des lames de scie par drone
quote: C'est ce qu'ont  retrouvé les gardiens de la maison d'arrêt de Nîmes après le crash d'un drone  dans la nuit du dimanche 8 au lundi 9 août, dans la cour nord de la prison, selon les informations d'un communiqué du syndicat Ufap-Unsa justice.
quote_translation: That is what the guards of Nîmes remand prison found after a drone crashed in the night of Sunday 8 to Monday 9 August in the prison's north yard, according to a communiqué from the Ufap-Unsa justice union.

place: near Piniers juvenile shelter, Ceuta border
summary: Man caught by Guardia Civil collecting a package flown from Morocco by drone containing 488 g of kiff; convicted by Juzgado de lo Penal 2, Ceuta, to 10 months and a EUR 600 fine.
payload_detail: 488 g kiff
source_title: Un juzgado de Ceuta dicta primera sentencia por tráfico drogas con drones
quote: fue sorprendido por la Guardia Civil el pasado día 3 de agosto de este año cuando acababa de recoger un paquete que había trasladado desde Marruecos un dron, cuyo vuelo fue seguido por los agentes del instituto armado.
quote_translation: was caught by the Guardia Civil on 3 August this year just after collecting a package that a drone had carried from Morocco, whose flight the officers followed.

place: Centro penitenciario de Ceuta (Los Rosales), módulo 8
summary: Drone with a red rope for hanging packages found in the yard of module 8 during a routine search; believed to have hit the wall and fallen inside; no package found.
source_title: Los presos ya usan drones para sus trapicheos en las cárceles españolas
quote: durante un registro rutinario en el módulo 8 de esta misma cárcel, se ha encontrado este aparato con una cuerda roja donde colgar paquetes para su traslado
quote_translation: during a routine search in module 8 of this same prison, this device was found with a red rope on which to hang packages for transfer

summary: A drone carrying metal saw blades landed in the yard of Nîmes prison and was found by guards before inmates reached it.
payload_detail: metal hacksaw blades
source_title: I droni usati per portare oggetti nelle carceri - Il Post
quote: Tre settimane fa, nel cortile del carcere di Nimes, in Francia, è atterrato un drone con alcuni seghetti da metallo.
quote_translation: Three weeks ago, in the yard of Nîmes prison in France, a drone landed with some metal hacksaws.

summary: Prison service DJI suspects drones delivered three iPhones and six SIM cards found in an open-air yard at the Zaanstad judicial complex. Two inmates were reprimanded.
payload_detail: three iPhones and six SIM cards
source_title: Drones dropped smartphones into Zaanstad prison
quote: During an inspection, three iPhones and six sim cards were found in an open-air yard at the penitentiary. The yard is not adjacent to an outside wall, so it is impossible that the smartphones were thrown over the wall as contraband is usually smuggled into penitentiaries. The DJI therefore suspects the use of drones.

place: Fuerte del Príncipe, barriada del Príncipe, Ceuta
summary: During an operation against hashish drone trafficking, Policía Nacional found a drone loaded with drugs near the Fuerte del Príncipe in Ceuta and seized it; quantity not stated. Nine people found in the fort were unrelated to the drug traffic.
payload_detail: quantity not specified by police
source_title: Operación Policía Nacional Príncipe detenidos
quote: En una de esas labores de vigilancia, los agentes localizaron un dron cargado con droga, lo que les condujo a entrar en el fuerte, descubriendo allí a los 9 marroquíes y gran cantidad de armas blancas
quote_translation: During one of these surveillance tasks, officers located a drone loaded with drugs, which led them to enter the fort, where they found the 9 Moroccans and a large quantity of bladed weapons

summary: Policía Nacional of Málaga presented a large Chinese-made drone, 4.5 m wingspan, 150 kg payload, seized from a French drug-trafficking group planning to settle on the Costa del Sol.
source_title: Los narcos del Estrecho usan drones ensamblados a mano con piezas de AliExpress - El Mundo
quote: El 13 de julio de 2021, la Policía Nacional de Málaga expuso durante una rueda de prensa un enorme dron de cuatro metros y medio de envergadura con capacidad para transportar hasta 150 kilos de carga, incautado a una banda de narcotraficantes franceses
quote_translation: On 13 July 2021 Málaga National Police displayed at a press conference a huge drone of 4.5 m wingspan able to carry up to 150 kilos, seized from a gang of French drug traffickers.

summary: 25 drone drops of drugs, phones and other contraband into two Midlands prisons, ordered by inmates by text; four people convicted or pleaded guilty at Coventry Crown Court, including a serving police detective.
payload_detail: heroin, cannabis, spice, mobile phones, sim cards, tobacco, wifi dongles, chargers
source_title: Serving detective and her husband used drones to smuggle thousands of pounds worth of heroin, cannabis and spice into prisons 'to order' to fund their luxury lifestyle
quote: The drone drops began on July 12 2021, with 25 in total taking place until February 27 2022, including seven in December 2021 alone, at prisons including Category B HMP Gartree, Leicestershire, and Category C HMP Onley in Warwickshire.

summary: Policía Nacional seized a 4.35 m wingspan drone, 7 h endurance, adapted to carry drugs from Morocco to Spain, at a rural house in Almáchar used as drug store. Four arrested (three in France, one in Spain) in Operation Piñas; announced 2021-07-13.
payload_detail: hashish and marijuana
source_title: Intervenido en Málaga un dron de 4,35 metros para traer droga desde Marruecos
quote: En el registro de una vivienda utilizada como lugar de almacenamiento de la droga en Almáchar fue intervenido, entre otros efectos, un dron profesional de 4,35 metros de envergadura -de un extremo a otro de las alas- y una autonomía de vuelo de siete horas, acondicionado para el transporte de droga entre Marruecos y España.
quote_translation: A professional drone with a 4.35 m wingspan and seven hours' flight endurance, adapted to carry drugs between Morocco and Spain, was seized, among other items, in a search of a house used as a drug store in Almáchar.

summary: Spanish police found a drug trafficking network that used a fleet of small drones to move cocaine from Morocco to Ceuta; seven drones were found.
payload_detail: cocaine; each drone capable of carrying 4 to 25 kg
source_title: Europe's biggest ever drug drone was just seized by Spanish cops
quote: In July this year , they found a network of drug traffickers that used a fleet of small drones to move cocaine from Morocco to Ceuta, an autonomous Spanish city near the coast of Africa. The police found seven drones, each capable of carrying between four and 25 kilograms.

place: Guadalete river, El Puerto de Santa María (Cádiz)
summary: Police operation against a hashish trafficking clan based in La Línea, with simultaneous searches in several Cádiz towns; 23 arrested; drones used to watch the Guadalete before landings were found.
source_title: La 'otra' Batalla del Guadalete
quote: Hubo 23 detenidos y los agentes encontraron hasta drones con los que vigilaban el Guadalete para poder llevar a cabo de la manera más segura sus alijos.
quote_translation: There were 23 arrests and officers even found drones used to watch the Guadalete so the landings could be carried out as safely as possible.

summary: A woman flew a drone package to a third-floor cell window at HMP Peterborough: 10 miniature phones, cannabis, tobacco. Police put the prison value at 5,800 GBP (cannabis) and 3,000 GBP (tobacco). One-year sentence suspended for two years, 150 hours unpaid work.
payload_detail: 10 miniature phones, cannabis, tobacco, cigarette papers
source_title: Woman used drone to smuggle phones and drugs into HMP Peterborough
quote: Prison officers were alerted to the drone flying within the grounds and witnessed it approach a third-floor window where the occupant took it through a hole in his window.

summary: Police searched a house in Almáchar used to store hashish and marijuana and seized a 4.35 m wingspan drone fitted for carrying drugs from Morocco to Spain; the occupant was arrested on a European Arrest Warrant. Three associates were arrested in France.
payload_detail: hashish and marijuana; 12 kg hashish seized in France
source_title: Intervenido un dron en una casa de Almáchar (Málaga) acondicionado para el transporte de droga entre Marruecos y España
quote: En el registro de una vivienda utilizada como lugar de almacenamiento de la droga en Almáchar fueron intervenido, entre otros efectos, un dron profesional de 4,35 metros de envergadura --de un extremo a otro de las alas-- y una autonomía de vuelo de siete horas, acondicionado para el transporte de droga entre Marruecos y España.
quote_translation: In the search of a house used to store the drugs in Almáchar, among other items, a professional drone with a 4.35 m wingspan and seven hours' flight endurance, fitted for transporting drugs between Morocco and Spain, was seized.

summary: A pistol was delivered by drone to a high-security inmate at Frosinone prison; he fired five shots at three inmates. Naples court sentenced Alessio Peluso to 15 years; prosecutors link the drone system to the Alleanza di Secondigliano.
payload_detail: one pistol
source_title: Frosinone, Spari in carcere, condannato
quote: L’arma utilizzata da Peluso per sparare, peraltro senza colpire gli altri tre detenuti se non uno preso appena di striscio, era arrivata in carcere proprio grazie a un drone.
quote_translation: The weapon Peluso used to shoot, without hitting the other three inmates except one grazed, had reached the prison thanks to a drone.

summary: Guardia Civil operation in Ceuta against a network flying drones between Ceuta and Morocco, sending psychotropic pills out and bringing small hashish loads back. 46 drones seized, 16 tied to the network; 10 arrested, all remanded in custody.
payload_detail: 125,625 clonazepam and 13,490 alprazolam pills; 77.3 kg hashish seized across the operation
source_title: Operación Etxea: así funcionaba la red de narcodrones
quote: Hasta la fecha, los agentes encargados de la inhibición de drones han recuperado un total de 46, de los que 16 puede constatarse de forma fehaciente que eran utilizados y manejados por la organización desarticulada.
quote_translation: To date, the agents in charge of drone jamming have recovered 46, of which 16 can be shown conclusively to have been used and operated by the dismantled organisation.

summary: Ofast investigation with arrests in Orléans (FR) and Spain; a fixed-wing VTOL drone found in a search at an isolated house in Vélez-Málaga, suspected test of cannabis resin transport from the Moroccan Rif to Costa del Sol.
payload_detail: planned: several dozen kilos of cannabis resin (test phase)
source_title: Trafic de stupéfiants : pour la première fois, un narco-drone a été saisi - lejdd.fr
quote: le modèle découvert le mois dernier en perquisition dans une maison isolée de Vélez-Málaga en Andalousie, un Mugin 4 450 VTOL made in China, pouvait remplir ces conditions.
quote_translation: the model found last month in a search of an isolated house in Vélez-Málaga, Andalusia, a Chinese-made Mugin 4 450 VTOL, could meet these conditions.

summary: A drone delivered a football sock of phones, cannabis and tobacco to a third-floor cell window at HMP Peterborough. A woman was traced via the inmate's calls, arrested and pleaded guilty; suspended sentence.
payload_detail: 10 miniature phones, a Zanco phone, cannabis, 6 packs of tobacco, 7 packs cigarette papers
source_title: Woman smuggled sock stuffed with phones and drugs via drone into prison | ITV News - ITVX
quote: Prison officers noticed the drone heading towards a third-floor window where the inmate took it through a hole in his window.

summary: Prison police noticed a drone approaching cell windows at Frosinone prison; it carried three mobile phones. The operator was not identified.
payload_detail: three mobile phones
source_title: Provincia di Frosinone – Droni per portare telefonini ai detenuti. La scoperta degli agenti di custodia del carcere del capoluogo
quote: Nel drone erano contenuti tre cellulari ma non si è riusciti a scoprire chi fosse, all’esterno della struttura penitenziaria, a manovrare il velivolo.
quote_translation: The drone contained three mobile phones but it was not possible to find out who was operating the aircraft outside the prison.

summary: Kuźnica Border Guard patrol saw a drone from Belarus drop a load 900 m from the border and turn back. Three people collecting it fled by car; the Polish driver tried to ram officers. 2,000 packs of unstamped cigarettes (about PLN 30,000) seized; two Belarusians and one Pole charged.
payload_detail: 2,000 packs cigarettes without Polish excise stamps, nearly PLN 30,000
source_title: Udaremniono przemyt przy użyciu drona
quote: Patrol Straży Granicznej z Kuźnicy zauważył lecący obiekt z Białorusi do Polski. Ustalono, że był to bezzałogowy statek powietrzny tzw. dron, który w odległości 900 metrów od granicy państwa zrzucił ładunek i zawrócił na Białoruś.
quote_translation: A Border Guard patrol from Kuźnica noticed an object flying from Belarus to Poland. It was established to be an unmanned aircraft, a so-called drone, which dropped its load 900 metres from the border and turned back to Belarus.

summary: Man arrested at night on a bike near HMP Parc with a drone and a holdall of cannabis, spice, Subutex, four phones and razor blades; suspected prison delivery. Pleaded guilty to possession with intent to supply.
payload_detail: cannabis, spice, Subutex (street value over £10,000), four mobile phones, razor blades
source_title: Newport man caught with drone and drugs worth £10k outside prison
quote: A MAN was caught near a prison wall with a drone and a bag full of drugs which had a street value of more than £10,000.

summary: A drone delivered a mobile phone to an inmate at Frosinone prison; the inmate destroyed it by swallowing the SIM when discovered.
payload_detail: 1 mobile phone
source_title: I droni usati per portare oggetti nelle carceri - Il Post
quote: Pochi giorni prima un altro drone era invece riuscito a consegnare un telefono cellulare a un detenuto che però, scoperto, lo aveva distrutto ingoiando a sua volta la sim.
quote_translation: A few days earlier another drone had delivered a mobile phone to an inmate who, when discovered, destroyed it by swallowing the SIM.

summary: Commissariato Vicaria Mercato arrested a 43-year-old under house arrest who used a drone from his terrace to monitor police and Carabinieri movements; 130 g heroin and 1,755 euro found. Investigators did not rule out drone deliveries to customers.
payload_detail: 130 g heroin (found at home, not on the drone)
source_title: Napoli: usava un drone per controllare spostamenti di Polizia e Carabinieri, pusher arrestato
quote: Napoli: usava un drone per controllare spostamenti di Polizia e Carabinieri, pusher arrestato
quote_translation: Naples: used a drone to monitor Police and Carabinieri movements, pusher arrested

place: Rivne section, Lutsk Border Detachment, Volyn Oblast
summary: Around midnight border guards found a UAV and a parcel of 500 packs of cigarettes prepared for transfer to the Polish side; a separate patrol found 2,000 packs moved from Belarus by a purpose-built device.
payload_detail: 500 packs prepared for transfer
source_title: На Волині затримали безпілотник, який мав перевезти сигарети до Польщі (фото)
quote: близько опівночі військовослужбовці відділу «Рівне», реалізовуючи оперативну інформацію, виявили в прикордонні безпілотний літальний апарат. Поряд знаходився пакунок з 500 пачками сигарет
quote_translation: around midnight, servicemen of the Rivne unit, acting on operational information, found an unmanned aerial vehicle in the border area. Next to it was a parcel of 500 packs of cigarettes.

summary: National Police and Guardia Civil dismantled a hashish network said to be led by a lieutenant of the 'Messi' group: 21 arrests after 16 searches; seized items included a drone with a thermal camera, stolen vehicles, contraband tobacco and over 18,000 euros cash.
source_title: Vaste opération antidrogue à Algésiras pour stopper le haschich marocain
quote: L’opération a également permis de récupérer quatre véhicules volés, 40 000 paquets de tabac de contrebande, un millier de litres d’essence, un drone avec une caméra thermique et plus de 18 000 euros en espèces.
quote_translation: The operation also recovered four stolen vehicles, 40,000 packs of contraband tobacco, a thousand litres of fuel, a drone with a thermal camera and more than 18,000 euros in cash.

summary: National police intercepted a drone carrying one kilo of Moroccan hashish that lost control and landed on a ship roof at the Tarajal polygon, Ceuta. Drone and drugs seized; investigation opened.
payload_detail: 1 kg hashish
source_title: Un drone transportant un kilo de haschich marocain intercepté à Ceuta
quote: La police nationale a intercepté lundi, un drone transportant un kilo de haschich marocain.
quote_translation: The national police intercepted on Monday a drone carrying one kilo of Moroccan hashish.

summary: Guardia Civil intercepted a drone near Tarajal carrying half a kilo of hashish in a bag tied to a hanging cord.
payload_detail: about 0.5 kg hashish
source_title: La red de narcodrones que quiso controlar el negocio entre fronteras
quote: El 4 de abril se interceptaba otro dron en la misma zona, esta vez portando medio kilo de hachís en una bolsa amarrada a la cuerda que colgaba del elevador.
quote_translation: On 4 April another drone was intercepted in the same area, this time carrying half a kilo of hashish in a bag tied to the cord hanging from the drone.

summary: Guardia Civil on patrol intercepted a drone carrying no drugs in the Arcos Quebrados area of Ceuta; no package found nearby. Date inferred from 'vendredi'. Smuggling purpose not stated.
source_title: Un drone transportant un kilo de haschich marocain intercepté à Ceuta
quote: Avant ce drone, la Garde civile, lors d’une patrouille dans la zone d’Arcos Quebrados, a intercepté vendredi un autre qui lui, ne transportait aucune drogue.
quote_translation: Before this drone, the Guardia Civil, on patrol in the Arcos Quebrados area, intercepted on Friday another one that was carrying no drugs.

place: Castellar de la Frontera (Cádiz); searches also in Málaga and Barcelona provinces
summary: Policía Nacional dismantled a network building large multi-motor aerial drones and unmanned semi-submersibles for drug traffickers. Eight arrested, six in pretrial detention; six aerial drones, three underwater drones, hashish, marijuana and cash seized.
payload_detail: 145 kg hashish and 8 kg marijuana seized; drones sized for 150-200 kg loads across the Strait of Gibraltar
source_title: Golpe del CNP a una red que fabricaba narcodrones conectada con Ceuta
quote: Y han sido intervenidos 145 kilos de hachís, 8 de marihuana, 157.370 euros, 10 vehículos y 6 drones de gran tamaño con hasta 12 motores y autonomía para 30 kilómetros, en los ocho registros practicados en las provincias de Málaga, Cádiz y Barcelona.
quote_translation: 145 kg of hashish, 8 kg of marijuana, 157,370 euros, 10 vehicles and 6 large drones with up to 12 motors and 30 km range were seized in the eight searches in Málaga, Cádiz and Barcelona provinces.

place: Naples base; deliveries to 18 prisons incl. Secondigliano, Frosinone, Cosenza, Siracusa, Augusta, Catania, Rovigo, Trapani, Saluzzo, Sulmona
summary: Naples DDA operation: 31 people subject to two custody orders (20 + 11, Polizia di Stato and prison police). Network supplied phones, drugs and firearms to prisons by drone, paid by camorra organisations; investigation began April 2021. A 52-year-old modified drones to carry more weight.
payload_detail: phones, drugs, firearms (quantities not in release)
source_title: Armi, droga e telefoni in carcere con i droni, 31 arresti a Napoli
quote: Tentativo di introduzione di materiale illecito sventato
quote_translation: Attempt to introduce illicit material foiled

place: Prisons at Veenhuizen, Krimpen aan den IJssel and Almelo
summary: Court in Dordrecht convicted a 34-year-old man from Rijsenhout, by plea agreement, of delivering drugs and phones to prisoners by drone. Prosecutors counted about 70 flights over 2021-2024 in NL, BE and LU; convicted for hashish at Veenhuizen and three iPhones at Krimpen and Almelo.
payload_detail: about 100 g hashish (Veenhuizen); packages with three iPhones (Krimpen aan den IJssel, Almelo)
source_title: Man (34) dropt drugs en telefoons in gevangenissen met drone, krijgt taakstraf
quote: Volgens justitie maakte S. tussen april 2021 en februari 2024 zeventig vluchten met drones om verboden goederen af te leveren aan gevangenen in Nederland, België en Luxemburg.
quote_translation: According to prosecutors, S. made seventy drone flights between April 2021 and February 2024 to deliver prohibited goods to prisoners in the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg.

summary: Second of three attempts to deliver drugs into HMP Gartree, by drone, arranged between an outside associate and an inmate using a phone. Unsuccessful. Associate arrested 13 Oct 2021; sentenced 28 Jun 2024 to 5 years consecutive on the prison-conveyance count.
payload_detail: unquantified Class A and B drugs; attempt unsuccessful
source_title: R v Mohammed Jakir Hussain [2025] EWCA Crim 419
quote: The second attempt took place on 31 March 2021, this time involving the use of a drone. The appellant and the inmate discussed test flights and used internet searches to research the payload and how to modify the device to make less noise when being used to deliver drugs into the prison.

summary: A drone arriving from Morocco came down near the La Reina district of Ceuta carrying a bag of drugs; local youths took the drone and cargo. Date inferred from 'mardi dernier' in a 27 March article.
source_title: Entre Sebta et le Maroc : les narco-drones tournent à plein régime
quote: l’un des drones en provenance du Maroc a échoué dans une zone proche des quartiers de la Reina, avec un sac chargé de drogue
quote_translation: one of the drones from Morocco ended up in an area near the La Reina neighbourhoods, with a bag loaded with drugs

summary: Two drones flew over Orléans-Saran prison for over two hours overnight 23-24 March 2021; a police source confirmed a report was received. Perpetrators not identified; union suspected reconnaissance for drug delivery or escape.
source_title: Le centre pénitentiaire d'Orléans-Saran survolé pendant plusieurs heures par de mystérieux drones
quote: Deux drones ont survolé pendant plus de deux heures la prison d'Orléans-Saran (Loiret), dans la nuit du 23 au 24 mars, a appris France Bleu Orléans de sources concordantes.
quote_translation: Two drones flew over Orléans-Saran prison for more than two hours on the night of 23 to 24 March, France Bleu Orléans learned from concurring sources.

summary: Three men tried to deliver nitrous oxide cartridges to Périgueux prison by drone from a neighbouring car park; police found them near a car with about twenty cartridges; two convicted, one minor not tried.
payload_detail: about twenty nitrous oxide (cream-charger) cartridges, too heavy for the drone
source_title: Dordogne : jugés pour avoir tenté de livrer du gaz hilarant en prison avec un drone - Sud Ouest
quote: Trois hommes ont tenté d’utiliser un drone pour livrer du gaz hilarant à la prison de Périgueux, en Dordogne. Deux ont été condamnés
quote_translation: Three men tried to use a drone to deliver laughing gas to Périgueux prison. Two were convicted.

summary: Three men aged 17, 19 and 23 were arrested near Périgueux prison while flying a drone, first empty as practice, with a parcel of nitrous oxide capsules and a speaker intended for an inmate friend; placed under judicial supervision, trial set for 23 April 2021.
payload_detail: nitrous oxide capsules and a music speaker
source_title: Avec un drone, ils tentent de livrer du gaz hilarant au-dessus de la prison de Périgueux
quote: Ils sont suspectés d'avoir utilisé un drone pour livrer des stupéfiants au sein de la maison d'arrêt.
quote_translation: They are suspected of having used a drone to deliver narcotics inside the remand prison.

summary: Drone loaded with a bundle of suspected cannabis crashed inside a high-security prison in Nancy; found by guards on a round. A phone with two USB cables and a bag of suspected heroin were found alongside.
payload_detail: bundle of suspected cannabis, bag of suspected heroin, phone with two USB cables
source_title: Se estrella dron cargado de droga dentro de una prisión en Francia
quote: Las autoridades francesas abrieron una investigación después de que un dron cargado con droga se estrellara el domingo dentro de una prisión de máxima seguridad en Nancy (noreste)
quote_translation: French authorities opened an investigation after a drone loaded with drugs crashed on Sunday inside a maximum-security prison in Nancy (northeast)

summary: Guardia Civil intercepted a drone flying from Castillejos towards El Príncipe; it was recovered at Tarajal while two individuals nearby tried to retrieve it and failed.
source_title: La red de narcodrones que quiso controlar el negocio entre fronteras
quote: El 20 de febrero, componentes del Instituto Armado interceptaban un dron procedente de Castillejos que tenía como ruta de destino el Príncipe.
quote_translation: On 20 February, Guardia Civil officers intercepted a drone from Castillejos whose destination route was El Príncipe.

summary: Policía Nacional and Guardia Civil dismantled a network ('Operation Rond-Hornet') flying drugs by drone between Morocco and Ceuta; 7 drones seized, 4 arrested, suspected leader remanded in custody.
payload_detail: hashish Morocco to Ceuta; 1,920 rivotril pills packed for Ceuta to Morocco
source_title: Juez decreta prisión al responsable de la primera red narcodrones en España
quote: Esta operación denominada "Rond-Hornet", primera que se realiza en España, permitió interceptar 4 drones semiindustriales con capacidades de carga desde los 4 hasta 25 kilogramos y otros 3 drones comerciales
quote_translation: This operation named "Rond-Hornet", the first in Spain, intercepted 4 semi-industrial drones with load capacities of 4 to 25 kilograms and 3 commercial drones

summary: Policía Nacional and Europol found a handmade unmanned underwater vehicle still under construction in a Málaga warehouse during a cocaine-trafficking investigation.
source_title: Drones submarinos narcotráfico Campo de Gibraltar Cádiz
quote: La encontraron la Policía Nacional y la Europol en una nave industrial en Málaga estando aún en construcción durante una investigación de tráfico de coca.
quote_translation: The National Police and Europol found it in an industrial warehouse in Málaga, still under construction, during a cocaine-trafficking investigation.

summary: Guardia Civil and Policía Nacional dismantled a network flying drones of up to 25 kg capacity carrying benzodiazepine pills from Ceuta to Morocco and hashish back; four semi-industrial and three commercial drones seized.
payload_detail: 1,920 Rivotril 2 mg tablets vacuum-packed; hashish and other substances inbound
source_title: Guardia Civil descabeza en Ceuta una red dedicada a llevar y traer drogas a Marruecos con drones
quote: A principios de febrero y en colaboración con la Policía Nacional se dio por desarticulada una trama supuestamente dedicada al "tráfico de internacional de drogas" con aparatos voladores no tripulados capaces de transportar hasta 25 kilogramos que llevaban pastillas de benzodiazepinas desde Ceuta hacia el Reino alauita
quote_translation: In early February, with Policía Nacional, a network allegedly dedicated to international drug trafficking with unmanned aircraft able to carry up to 25 kg, taking benzodiazepine pills from Ceuta to Morocco, was dismantled.

summary: A drone carrying drugs and a phone crashed inside the grounds of Nancy-Maxéville prison in February 2021, as reported by AFP.
source_title: «Lanceur 2.0»: ils utilisent un drone pour tenter de livrer du gaz hilarant à un détenu à Périgueux
quote: En février, un drone s’est écrasé dans l’enceinte du centre pénitentiaire de Nancy-Maxéville, rapporte l’AFP. Il transportait de la drogue et un téléphone.
quote_translation: In February, a drone crashed within the grounds of Nancy-Maxéville prison, AFP reports. It was carrying drugs and a phone.

place: HMP Risley, Warrington (drone flights); raids in Crewe and Alsager
summary: Cheshire Police raided addresses in Crewe and Alsager and seized four drones, controller, batteries and drugs from a shed, ending a drone conspiracy supplying HMP Risley. Seven defendants pleaded guilty; sentenced at Liverpool Crown Court.
payload_detail: ketamine, cocaine, MDMA, cannabis, mobile phones, SIM cards
source_title: Inmate integral to prison drone-drug conspiracy is handed more time behind bars - Warrington Guardian
quote: Ketamine, cocaine, MDMA and cannabis, with a street value of around £8,000 and prison value of around £78,200, were seized from a shed, as well as four drones, a controller and batteries.

summary: Squadra mobile of Treviso arrested a 38-year-old for heroin dealing; a drone was reportedly used to reach customers waiting near his house. Date is the arrest date.
source_title: Follina, consegne con il drone e la casa per consumare eroina e coca - Corriere del Veneto
quote: Erano arrivati perfino ad utilizzare un drone che raggiungeva il cliente, il quale restava solitamente in attesa, nei paraggi dell’abitazione
quote_translation: They had even used a drone that reached the customer, who usually waited near the house.

place: St John's Square near Portlaoise Prison, Co. Laois
summary: Gardaí seized a drone with a package of phones, chargers, crack cocaine, cocaine and cannabis (about €5,000) near Portlaoise Prison and arrested a man in his 20s. He was charged on 8 Jan 2021 and bailed on condition he not fly drones near places of detention.
payload_detail: mobile phones, chargers, crack cocaine, cocaine, cannabis; est. €5,000
source_title: Drone and drugs seized by Garda in Portlaoise 6/1/21 arrest
quote: Gardaí have arrested a man in his 20s following the seizure of a drone along with a package containing mobile phones, chargers and quantities of crack cocaine, cocaine and cannabis, with a combined estimated value of €5,000 (analysis pending).

place: Centre de détention de Châteaudun, Eure-et-Loir
summary: Six people were tried at Chartres criminal court in January 2021 for supplying drugs, including by drone, to Châteaudun detention centre; a 25-year-old inmate who ordered the parcels got five years and the drone pilot three years.
source_title: «Lanceur 2.0»: ils utilisent un drone pour tenter de livrer du gaz hilarant à un détenu à Périgueux
quote: Un détenu de 25 ans, commanditaire des colis, a été condamné à cinq ans de prison ferme alors que le pilote du drone a écopé de trois ans de prison ferme avec maintien en détention pour les deux
quote_translation: A 25-year-old inmate, who ordered the parcels, was sentenced to five years in prison while the drone pilot got three years in prison, both kept in detention.

summary: A man was jailed for six months in January 2021 for trying to fly several mobile phones into Perth Prison by drone.
payload_detail: several mobile phones
source_title: Police Scotland given criminals' drone to add to its fleet
quote: Criminal cases involving drones have include a man being jailed for six months in January after trying to fly several mobile phones into Perth Prison by drone.

summary: Gardaí foiled an attempt by a criminal gang to deliver a drugs package, mobile phones and chargers into Portlaoise Prison by drone, in January 2021.
payload_detail: drugs package valued at €5,000, mobile phones and chargers
source_title: Inmates 'smuggling mini sim cards into prison in their foreskins'
quote: Last January, gardaí foiled an attempt by a criminal gang to deliver a €5,000 drugs package, mobile phones and chargers into Portlaoise Prison using a drone.

summary: Staff at Saint-Gilles prison intercepted a drone with a parcel hanging on a long line, containing glue for sniffing, a phone charger and marijuana.
payload_detail: glue for sniffing, phone charger, marijuana
source_title: Dürüm, drogue, GSM… : les livraisons par drone, véritable cauchemar des établissements pénitentiaires
quote: En 2021, le personnel de la prison de Saint-Gilles avait intercepté un drone. Un paquet y était accroché par un long fil. Ils avaient réussi à attraper le drone et ont donc intercepté le paquet, qui contenait de la colle destinée à être sniffée, un chargeur de téléphone et de la marijuana.
quote_translation: In 2021, staff at Saint-Gilles prison intercepted a drone. A parcel hung from it on a long line. They caught the drone and so intercepted the parcel, which held glue meant for sniffing, a phone charger and marijuana.

summary: Police found a group receiving alpha-PVP sent by drone from Ivangorod, Russia, across the Narva river into Narva; six such deliveries were found in the investigation and the group was caught on the sixth. Four people were suspected, three in custody.
payload_detail: alpha-PVP (quantity not stated)
source_title: Politsei tabas mullu Narvas kaks droone kasutanud salakaubavedajate gruppi
quote: Narkootikumid saadeti Ivangorodist drooniga üle Narva jõe Narva linna. Meie avastasime kriminaalmenetluse käigus kuus sellist korda. Kuuendal korral pidasime nad kinni.
quote_translation: The drugs were sent from Ivangorod by drone across the Narva river to the town of Narva. We found six such occasions in the criminal proceedings. On the sixth occasion we detained them.

summary: Operación Piñas (Policía Nacional with French police): a drone loaded with hashish that had crossed the Strait of Gibraltar was found; an organisation buying hashish and marijuana in Morocco for France was dismantled.
payload_detail: hashish
source_title: Narcotráfico: Detenidos en Castellar un hombre y su hijo por fabricar dobles fondos en vehículos y drones para llevar droga
quote: En 2021, la Policía Nacional encontró un dron cargado de hachís tras cruzar el Estrecho de Gibraltar.
quote_translation: In 2021, the National Police found a drone loaded with hashish after it crossed the Strait of Gibraltar.

summary: Spanish and French police seized an air drone able to carry up to 150 kg, used to transport drugs from Morocco to southern Spain. Reported as 'last summer' in a July 2022 article.
source_title: Spanish police bust gang making underwater drug drones
quote: Last summer, Spanish and French police seized an air drone capable of carrying up to 150 kilograms (330 pounds) of cargo, which was used to transport drugs from Morocco to southern Spain.

summary: Guardia Civil officers identified three individuals near Mendizábal prison at a spot the force considers strategic for introducing weapons, phones and drugs into the prison by drone.
source_title: La red de narcodrones que quiso controlar el negocio entre fronteras
quote: Personal de la Compañía de Seguridad Ciudadana llegó a identificar a tres individuos cerca de la prisión de Mendizábal, en las proximidades del fuerte, considerado un punto estratégico para intentar “la introducción de armas, teléfonos y drogas al centro penitenciario mediante el empleo de drones”.
quote_translation: Citizen Security Company staff identified three individuals near Mendizábal prison, near the fort, considered a strategic point for attempting to introduce weapons, phones and drugs into the prison by drone.

summary: Drone with drug and mobile phone package recovered at HMP Edinburgh in 2021, per FOI response.
source_title: Police probe after failed bid to smuggle drugs into Inverness prison with drone
quote: Drones with similar drug and mobile phone packages were also recovered at HMP Edinburgh, HMP Addiewell and HMP Barlinnie.

place: HMP Gartree, HMP Onley, HMP Oakwood and other Midlands prisons
summary: Gang including a serving police detective constable sent 27 packages of drugs, phones, SIM cards and surgical blades into Midlands prisons by drone over eight months in 2021-22; 12 parcels recovered. Three members jailed at Wolverhampton Crown Court; one sentence deferred.
payload_detail: Class A drugs, cannabis, tobacco, spice, phones, SIM cards, memory cards, surgical blades
source_title: Three members of a drugs gang which included a serving police officer are jailed over conspiracy to fly drugs, blades and phones into prisons with drones
quote: A court heard  the couple, who are now estranged, and their two accomplices, career criminal Mervyn Foster and former drug counsellor-turned-drone pilot Kent George, sent a total of 27 packages into prisons over an eight month period.

summary: Hungarian tax and customs authority (NAV) and police met smugglers using drones and unmanned aircraft at the Ukrainian-Hungarian green border, tracked them by thermal camera, and seized over 6,700 boxes of cigarettes and two aircraft.
payload_detail: more than 6,700 boxes of cigarettes
source_title: Cigarettacsempészet drónnal
quote: A légi eszközöket az orgazdák az ukrán-magyar határnál vetették be, a pénzügyőrök pedig hőkamerákkal követték útjukat. Ennek eredményeképpen több mint 6700 doboz cigarettát és két gépet találtak és foglaltak le.
quote_translation: The smugglers used the aircraft at the Ukrainian-Hungarian border and customs officers tracked them with thermal cameras. As a result, more than 6,700 boxes of cigarettes and two machines were found and seized.

summary: Man in his 20s arrested near Portlaoise Prison after a drone was seized with a package of phones, chargers and drugs.
payload_detail: mobile phones, chargers, crack cocaine, powder cocaine, cannabis
source_title: Prison seizures of phones, drugs and weapons surges as 'traditional' smuggling returns at jails in Portlaoise and elsewhere
quote: A man in his 20s was arrested in early 2021 near  Portlaoise  Prison following the seizure of a drone, along with a package containing mobile phones, chargers, quantities of crack cocaine, powder cocaine and cannabis.

summary: A gun was delivered by drone to a Camorra-linked inmate in Frosinone prison, who then fired a shot in a revenge shooting over a beating.
source_title: Andrea Kercanaj, dallo spaccio agli spari in carcere: rimpatriato il boss albanese di Frosinone - Il Messaggero
quote: Nel 2021, restò coinvolto in una sparatoria. A fare fuoco, con un'arma recapitata poco prima con un drone
quote_translation: In 2021 he was involved in a shooting. The shooter, with a weapon delivered shortly before by drone

place: PI Lelystad, PI Veenhuizen, PI Zaandam (also prisons in Belgium and Luxembourg)
summary: Three men from Amsterdam, Schiedam and Rijsenhout arrested 5 March 2024 on suspicion of criminal organisation; on order they flew drugs and phones by drone to inmates since 2021, incl. one phone delivered to a cell window. Drones, parts and drugs seized.
source_title: Drugs en telefoons via drones in gevangenissen gedropt - Politie.nl
quote: Op dinsdag 5 maart zijn drie mannen aangehouden die verdacht worden van deelname aan een criminele organisatie. De verdachten zouden de drugs en telefoons op bestelling afleveren in verschillende penitentiaire inrichtingen (PI).
quote_translation: On Tuesday 5 March three men were arrested on suspicion of participating in a criminal organisation. The suspects allegedly delivered drugs and telephones to order at several prisons.
